name: oss-docs
domain: OSS project public documentation — GitHub README (4-locale) + Hugo geekdoc docs-site (docs-site/, content/{ko,en,ja,zh}, ko-canonical) deployed to adk.mo.ai.kr via Vercel. Automates README redesign/maintenance and docs-site authoring/menu-restructuring with strict 4-locale synchronization.
source_request: 오픈소스 프로젝트의 깃허브와 온라인 문서를 제작하는 하네스를 생성해라. 본 프로젝트의 README.md와 docs-site의 업무는 다룬다. .moai/reports/readme-docs-redesign-20260713.md 참고해서 하네스 제작해라

specialists.description: Author/rewrite canonical-locale source content (ko for docs-site pages, en for README): README section redesign per SSOT report, new docs pages, heading hierarchy, TD-only Mermaid, icon shortcodes over body emoji. Produces the single source of truth; does not translate.

Derive the 3 non-canonical locales in the same PR (ko->en->ja/zh for docs, en->ko/ja/zh for README), preserving facts/figures/code/icon-shortcodes/Mermaid direction, applying per-locale emphasis-marker spacing and URL-blacklist compliance. One parallel worker per derived locale.

Maintain docs-site structure/navigation: per-locale _meta.yaml section order, data/menu/main.yaml 4-locale name maps + icons, matching SVG cases in layouts/partials/menu.html, vercel.json redirects for moved pages; reconcile _meta.yaml/main.yaml divergences. Single-writer on shared config.
